params.body:
The topic blocks on Insights, Patterns and the Buffer were a dark slab: a near-black ramp left over from the dark theme, with the biggest topic the lightest, next to a map that runs from paper to blue.

- One ramp for counts in `components/heat.js`, the map's: light to dark as the count grows. The blocks use its light steps and never the darkest, so the biggest topic is the strongest blue and nothing is black.
- Text on a block reads on its fill: ink on the light steps, white on the dark ones.
- The section labels on those pages and the map's title lose their spaced capitals ("By topic", "Coverage by region").

Build ok, lint ratchet at its ceiling.
params.title: Coverage: lighter topic blocks, one ramp with the map
